text: Implemented one projection contract: Projector/BiProjection/CrossProjection now hold MvMap, BlockMap is used directly in BiProjection and MultiblockProjection is removed, and CPCA constraints expose projector/coordinate MvMaps with decoder-backed projection. Verified focused JVM+JS acceptance suites and full multivar JVM+JS gates: sbt "multivarJVM/testOnly scalafim.multivar.MapAlgebraSuite scalafim.multivar.MultiblockSuite scalafim.multivar.CpcaSuite"; sbt "multivarJS/testOnly scalafim.multivar.MapAlgebraSuite scalafim.multivar.MultiblockSuite scalafim.multivar.CpcaSuite"; sbt multivarJVM/test; sbt multivarJS/test.
